title: Manual Silane Magnetic Bead-Based High Throughput Protocol for SARS-CoV-2 RNA Extraction
author: Ainhoa Goñi-Salaverri
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfmajk2e
materials: Following oropharyngeal and/or nasopharyngeal swab collection, place the swab directly into a 2 mL safe-lock tube containing 800 l of RLT-plus buffer (Qiagen). * When collected in RLT plus the viral particles become inactive. This provides further biosafety for the process. However, samples should be always considered as extremely biohazardous and handled with extreme caution inside a Level 2 biosafety hood.

steps.title: Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the SARS-CoV-2 samples for extraction inside a Biosafety Level 2 Cabinet following WHO guidelines.

substeps.instruction: Cut the swab's stem and close the tube.
If samples were transported or stored frozen, let them thaw for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer 150 μl of sample in RLT to a well in an Eppendorf deep-well plate (250 μl capacity).
When processing 48 or fewer samples, assemble them in alternating columns to minimize contamination risk.
Return the tube with the remaining sample to the original box and record the position of each sample in the 96-well plate.

steps.title: Wash and Resuspend Silane Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare the Silane beads (stored at 4C) outside the flow hood.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 15 μl of beads per sample into a 2 mL ED tube (include a 15% overage, e.g., 1,665 μl for 96 samples).
Concentrate beads to the tube wall using a DynaMag-2 magnet and remove the bead storage suspension media.
Wash 1X with 1 mL of RLT-plus buffer and remove the buffer using the magnet.
Resuspend the beads in 10 μl of RLT-plus buffer per sample.

steps.title: Prepare Bead-Ethanol Mixture
steps.instruction: Create a bead-ethanol mixture for the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Pipette the required amount of pre-washed Silane beads (10 μl/sample) into a 15 mL tube (include a 15% overage, e.g., 1,110 μl for 96 samples).
Add 70 μl of 100% EtOH per sample (e.g., 7,770 μl for 96 samples).
Vortex the mixture and keep at room temperature.
Pour the mixture into a reservoir.

steps.title: Bind RNA to Beads
steps.instruction: Combine the sample with the bead mixture to bind the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Use a multichannel pipette to add 80 μl of the Silane bead/ethanol mixture into each sample well.
Mix well by pipetting up and down 15 times.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Magnetize and Wash Beads
steps.instruction: Isolate the beads and wash away contaminants using ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Place the plate on a DynaMag-96 side skirted magnet and incubate for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant using an 8-channel vacuum aspirator or a multichannel pipette while the plate is still on the magnet.
Add 200 μl of 80% EtOH from a reservoir and incubate for 30 seconds; do not resuspend the beads.
Aspirate the ethanol using an 8-channel vacuum aspirator or a multichannel pipette.
Repeat the addition of 150 μl of 80% EtOH and incubate for 30 seconds; do not resuspend the beads.
Slowly aspirate the ethanol, ensuring no small droplets remain to avoid inhibiting RT-qPCR.

steps.title: Dry and Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Dry the beads and elute the bound RNA.

substeps.instruction: Remove the plate from the magnet and let the beads dry inside the hood for 1 minute (avoid over-drying).
Add 30-50 μl of preheated 10 mM Tris pH 7.5 from a reservoir and resuspend the beads by pipetting up and down thoroughly.
If beads are difficult to resuspend, incubate for 3 minutes at 37C and try again.
Incubate at 37C for 3 minutes to increase elution yield (this step is optional if yield is sufficient).
Place the plate on the DynaMag-96 side skirted magnet for 1 minute.
Transfer the supernatant into a new 96-well plate.
